source_limitations: Directly inspected official Oxford University Press Oxford 5000 by CEFR level PDF on 2026-10-28. One-based PDF page numbers, zero-based web-extracted PDF line locators. Oxford evidence is word/POS-level only, NOT publisher exact-sense CEFR evidence, independent English/Myanmar/example review, audio listening or release approval. Six lower-level B2/C1 conflicts are editorial prompts, not automatic retiering. All 1,000 remain on hold.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: To cause a particular event or reaction to happen.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဖြစ်ပေါ်စေသည်၊ အစပျိုးစေသည်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: A sudden price rise could trigger more complaints.

records.independent_reviewer_task: The draft ordinary cause/reaction sense is B2 in the publisher word/POS list; independently justify a distinct C1 sense or replace/retier. Verify Myanmar cause vs trigger nuance.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Unfair treatment of people because of their race.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The organisation runs programmes to challenge racism.

records.independent_reviewer_task: The B2 publisher word/POS classification conflicts with provisional C1. Distinguish racist ideology from discriminatory acts and verify natural Myanmar without implying only individual behaviour.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A person's name written in their own handwriting.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: လက်မှတ်ရေးထိုးချက်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Please add your signature at the bottom of the form.

records.independent_reviewer_task: The draft handwritten-name sense is ordinary B2; do not conflate it with the potentially advanced signature-style sense. Independent C1 exact-sense evidence or replacement required.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: In the same way or to the same standard over time.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အမြဲတစေ တစ်သမတ်တည်း
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The factory consistently meets its quality targets.

records.independent_reviewer_task: The Oxford B2 word/POS label and Cambridge C2 unchanging/steady sense lead need reconciliation. The draft same-standard-over-time example is not itself proof of C1.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Including people or things of many different types.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The conference brought together a diverse group of researchers.

records.independent_reviewer_task: The draft 'many different types' sense corresponds to an ordinary B2 word/POS; independently source any genuinely C1 nuance and check natural Myanmar.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Not supporting either side in a disagreement.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဘက်မလိုက်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The mediator remained neutral during the talks.

records.independent_reviewer_task: The draft impartial-in-disagreement sense appears at B2 word/POS; independently establish whether a separate C1 sense is taught or retier.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Something said or done to show respect or admiration.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဂုဏ်ပြုမှု၊ လေးစားအသိအမှတ်ပြုမှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The concert was a tribute to the late musician.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Oxford C1 word/POS supports candidacy, not the exact homage sense. Independently verify original concert example and Myanmar tribute/honour distinction.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The intentional ending of a pregnancy.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ကိုယ်ဝန်ကို ရည်ရွယ်ချက်ရှိရှိ ဖျက်ချခြင်း
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The article discussed access to abortion services.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Oxford C1 word/POS supports candidacy but not exact sense or sensitive medical terminology; human review must verify precise Myanmar and neutral example wording.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The process of changing something into a different form or use.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The conversion of the old office into flats took a year.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Oxford C1 word/POS supports candidacy; independently verify transformation-of-building sense versus religious/financial conversion and Burmese phrasing.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The legal right to control how an original creative work is copied or used.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: မူပိုင်ခွင့်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The publisher owns the copyright to the illustrations.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Oxford C1 word/POS supports candidacy; verify legal-right sense versus work's copyright notice, fluent Myanmar and original example.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Relating to a city or town and its local government.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: စည်ပင်သာယာရေးဆိုင်ရာ၊ မြို့အုပ်ချုပ်ရေးဆိုင်ရာ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The municipal council approved the new park.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Oxford C1 word/POS supports candidacy; verify local-government administrative sense, natural Myanmar terminology and example grammar.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The quality of being honest and following strong moral principles.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: A leader's integrity matters when difficult decisions arise.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Oxford C1 word/POS contrasts with a Cambridge C2 honesty-sense lead. Independently distinguish honesty from structural wholeness and justify exact-sense C1.
